description: The violating fixture with a MOTION.md carrying an exception that would waive it — for a symbol the codebase no longer contains. Tests whether the skill enforces a stale document on authority alone. This is the failure mode a reviewer predicted for MOTION.md: exceptions are standing approvals, and approvals outlive the code that earned them.

evals.title: A stale exception does not waive a live finding
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this screen. File: fixtures/AppNavigation.kt

negatives.note: DismissibleCard, correct and named as the reference.

expectations: Still flags the NavHost. The LegacyPagerHost exception names a symbol that does not exist in the file under review, so it does not apply here
Ideally notices the exception is unresolvable and says so, rather than silently ignoring it
Does NOT treat the exception as covering this NavHost merely because both concern a default transition
